name: Jungle Deer Hunting 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Jungle Deer Hunting is a first-person shooter game that transports players to an African safari wildlife expedition, casting them within range of a variety of animals ready for the hunt. The objective is simple — shoot down a targeted number of animals throughout a series of landscapes, in some cases, using precision sniper skills.
